subject: Admin activity evidence — bundling schema, export protocol, and transport ops
messages:
From: Jessica Hall <jessica.hall@brooksidehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: admin activity extract for SOC 2 evidence (scope & format)

Markus —

Thanks for taking this. Brookside's SOC 2 auditor has asked for an extract of 'admin activity' (privileged actions, role grants, policy changes, credential changes, token issuance/revocation) covering the last 12 months. They want a machine-readable bundle we can ingest into our evidence repo.

Questions / asks:
- Can you confirm the exact event fields you can provide (actor id, action, target resource, timestamp, request_id/session_id, IP, region, pre/post values, change summary)?
- Preferred delivery formats: CSV + gzipped JSONL? We need checksums and an attested manifest (HMAC or signed manifest).
- Retention window: auditor wants daily snapshots and a separate on-demand delta export for the full 12 months. Is that possible, and what is the expected turnaround?
- Any PII that will be present in events (user emails, IPs) — can we request redaction/pseudonymization options?

We also use automated ingestion that prefers timestamps normalized to UTC (ISO8601). If you have a spec or README for the export, please attach.

Thanks — we'll need to include this in the audit packet next week.

Jessica Hall
Compliance Manager, Brookside Health
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Hall <jessica.hall@brooksidehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity extract for SOC 2 evidence (scope & format)

Hi Jessica — thanks for the clear asks. Summary of what we can deliver and the plan: 

1) Event fields we will include (per-event):
- event_timestamp (ISO8601 UTC)
- actor_internal_id (redwood user id)
- actor_email (we can pseudonymize on request)
- actor_role
- action_type (enum: GRANT_ROLE, REVOKE_ROLE, CHANGE_POLICY, CREATE_API_KEY, REVOKE_API_KEY, LOGIN_FAILURE, LOGIN_SUCCESS, DELETE_RESOURCE, UPDATE_RESOURCE)
- resource_type
- resource_id
- request_id
- session_id
- ip_address (we can hash / pseudonymize)
- region
- prior_value_summary
- new_value_summary
- change_diff (short text)
- service_component

2) Formats and files we will produce:
- full_snapshot_YYYYMMDD.jsonl.gz (event-per-line JSONL, gzipped)
- daily_delta_YYYYMMDD.csv.gz (CSV with same canonical fields)
- admin_activity_manifest.csv (CSV manifest listing file name, sha256, gzip_size_bytes, record_count, start_ts, end_ts, export_agent, export_timestamp)
- export_readme.md (export schema, timezone, redaction options, KMS key id)

3) Integrity and attestation:
- We will provide sha256 checksums for each file in the manifest and a signed HMAC manifest using the KMS key configured for Brookside (we need your KMS key id or a public signing key).
- Optional: we can produce a signed attestation PDF that lists sampling methodology and redaction steps.

4) Retention/packaging options:
- We can produce the 12-month full snapshot as either: (a) one full JSONL.gz bundle (recommended for offline ingestion), or (b) monthly buckets (preferred if you want smaller objects).
- Daily delta exports are available as CSV.gz for each day.

5) PII/redaction:
- We can deliver event-level PII in three modes: RAW (emails and IPs included), HASHED (sha256 of email/IP), or REDACTED (remove fields). Hashing is deterministic and preserves correlation where auditors need to link actor across events.

Proposed timeline: 3 business days for initial export (monthly-bucketed full snapshot + last 30 days of daily deltas). 5 business days if you require full 12-month single bundle + signed attestation.

I have attached an example JSONL.gz and a manifest stub for reference. If you can confirm preferred redaction mode and delivery method (S3 presigned PUTs to your uploads@ endpoint vs. SFTP vs. direct Drive link), we'll schedule the job.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Field Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Hall <jessica.hall@brooksidehealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity extract for SOC 2 evidence (scope & format)

Jessica — quick technical clarifications (so the auditor can map their ingestion):

- Time normalization: all event_timestamp fields will be in UTC (Z) and use RFC3339 / ISO8601 (e.g. 2024-10-12T18:32:21Z). Exports will include start_ts and end_ts in manifest in the same format.
- CSV dialect: UTF-8, comma, quoted fields when needed, header row present. Nulls are empty strings.
- Compression: .gz (gzip level 6) for all artifacts.
- Record ordering: JSONL snapshot is ordered by event_timestamp ascending.
- Session vs. request: session_id is the user session; request_id is per-API request (both included when available).
- Operator mapping: actor_internal_id maps to our internal directory. If you need a persistent pseudonym mapping (hash -> consistent alias), we will provide a mapping file (separate, access-controlled).
- Zone normalization: all timestamps will be normalized to UTC at export; we will not convert event times to customer local TZ.

Operational ops: we can upload to a pre-provisioned S3 bucket (we will require an upload role ARN or presigned PUTs). Alternatively, we can push to your uploads@brooksidehealth.com SFTP endpoint if you prefer encrypted transport. If you choose S3, we will add an encrypted manifest (encrypted with your public key or our KMS wrapping).

Attached: manifest_schema_v1.json (schema for admin_activity_manifest.csv) and an example compressed JSONL.

-Kimberly
Senior Engineering Manager, Audit & Evidence
Redwood Inference
From: Jessica Hall <jessica.hall@brooksidehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity extract for SOC 2 evidence (scope & format)

Thanks — this looks good and covers what our auditor requested. A few clarifications before you run the job: 

- Delivery: Please use S3 presigned PUTs; I'll have our security team create one-time presigned PUTs for the bucket uploads@brookside (I will send the list this afternoon).
- Redaction: HASHED mode for actor_email and ip_address is fine — we need deterministic hashing. Please include the mapping file (hash -> internal_id) but encrypt it and deliver it separately to Compliance Uploads.
- Timestamps: please make sure the event_timestamp is the ingestion timestamp (server-side) rather than an application-level timezone-corrected time — the auditor compares ingestion vs. application times.
- Turnaround: 3 business days for the monthly-bucketed snapshot + last 30 days of deltas is acceptable. If you hit any blockers, loop me in.

We'll include the manifest and checksums in the evidence packet. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Jessica Hall
Compliance Manager, Brookside Health
